name: Shape Physics
description: A playful physics canvas that fills with 3D characters: spheres, cones, cubes, clouds, drops and thick flowers that tumble, pile up and follow the cursor. Drag and drop them, or keep them flat in 2D.

controls.name: depth
controls.label: Depth
controls.description: 3D volumes tumble and show their sides; 2D keeps the same figures flat.

controls.name: shape
controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Mix figures or give every figure the same shape: spheres, cones, cubes, clouds, drops or flowers.

controls.name: followCursor
controls.label: Follow cursor
controls.description: Enable mouse or pen tracking for a stable subset of figures. Works during pause; disabling restores the authored expressions.

controls.name: cursorFollowRatio
controls.label: Cursor followers
controls.description: Fraction of figures that follow the cursor. The remaining figures keep their independent idle gaze. Use 0 for none or 1 for all.

controls.name: count
controls.label: Object count
controls.description: Upper limit for automatic figures. They keep falling in until the container is full, then stop.

controls.name: size
controls.label: Object radius (px)
controls.description: Largest figure radius. Increasing it stops when the current figures would overfill the container.

controls.name: sizeVariation
controls.label: Size variation
controls.description: Variation below the largest radius. Zero gives every object the same size.

controls.name: spawnRate
controls.label: Objects per second
controls.description: Figures falling in per second until the container is full.

controls.name: appearanceDuration
controls.label: Appearance duration (s)
controls.description: Time for each object to grow into view. Flowers unfold petal by petal; zero creates complete shapes.

controls.name: seed
controls.label: Random seed
controls.description: Reproducible shapes and placement. Changing this value replays the field.

controls.name: gravity
controls.label: Gravity (px/s²)
controls.description: Downward acceleration. Zero makes objects weightless; negative values pull upward.

controls.name: wind
controls.label: Wind (px/s²)
controls.description: Horizontal acceleration. Negative values push left.

controls.name: restitution
controls.label: Bounce
controls.description: Energy retained after impact. Slow contacts settle without continual bouncing.

controls.name: friction
controls.label: Contact friction
controls.description: Resistance to sliding along objects and canvas boundaries.

controls.name: damping
controls.label: Air resistance
controls.description: Exponential damping of linear and angular velocity.

controls.name: spin
controls.label: Initial spin
controls.description: Initial spin of new figures, in the screen plane and (in 3D) out of it.
